question_text: Outline a privacy concern when machine learning identifies individual drivers from roadside images.
adaptation_rationale: Retain privacy concern in explicitly ML-based camera analysis, avoiding general surveillance scope assumptions. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Identifiable travel records reveal people’s movements; storing/combining them without informed consent creates intrusive monitoring.

partial_credit_notes: Award each specified criterion independently up to the allocation. Credit correct method after an earlier slip when consistent; do not award the same point twice.
